title: Answer: perturb the field, measure synchrony, build field computers

statements.text: The theory is checked by measuring whether synchrony tracks conscious perception, by applying shaped external fields at set frequency and phase to reinforce or inhibit responses tied to event-related potentials, and by testing whether field-computing machines, unlike digital ones, show signs of consciousness.

sources.quote: the cemi field theory also makes predictions that have yet to be tested, such as the possibility of inhibiting specific responses through specific external EM field perturbations
